name: Return to Primal Torntusk
label: Quest
description: Elder Torntusk asks you to return to his mate, Primal Torntusk, at Revantusk Village and tell her that he is coming home.
intro: Elder Torntusk asks you to return to his mate, Primal Torntusk, at Revantusk Village and tell her that he is coming home.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Return to my mate, Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village. Tell her that I am coming home! She is sure to reward you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done the Revantusk a great service, friend! We owe you a great debt of gratitude.
